finding: FBX2EDF negates Z; old positive FBX Z placed scenery at negative game Z
evidence: Six sampled v004 FBX vertices matched compiled MAP only after Z negation. Example FBXmetres[162.52507019,2.93679619,303.13800049] matched MAPbyte476 as[162.52507019,2.93679619,-303.13800049].
fix: Use Blender (x,z,height), standard -Z forward/Y up FBX. Compiled scenery then occupies positive game X/Z. Native terrain and lap unchanged.
